name: Loja do Mecânico
description: Brazilian online store of tools and machinery for workshops and professionals. Categories include electric and hand tools, pneumatic tools, auto-center equipment, car-wash equipment, gardening, construction and personal protective equipment. Its homepage quotes delivery by postal code and links a page of physical stores; the delivery area is not stated there.
description_es: Tienda online brasileña de herramientas y maquinaria para talleres y profesionales. Las categorías incluyen herramientas eléctricas y manuales, neumáticas, equipos para centros automotrices, lavado de autos, jardinería, construcción y equipos de protección personal. Su página principal calcula la entrega por código postal y enlaza una página de tiendas físicas; el área de entrega no figura allí.

ships_to.notes: Homepage has a ship-to field that asks for the postal code (CEP) but states no coverage area.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Homepage links a page of physical stores; pickup is not stated.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

shopping_notes: Prices in BRL. Shipping quoted by CEP. Some inner pages redirect automated clients to a bot-protection check.

sources.supports: product categories, CEP shipping field, physical stores link
